tests.title: Sort range A1:C6 by Sales ascending with header row and verify row order persists after refresh
checks: Sort range dialog appears with Sort by options Region/Sales/Status and Order options Ascending/Descending
Data has header row checked; after Sort the header Region/Sales/Status stays first and data rows are South/700/Open, North/800/Closed, East/1200/Open
Entire records move together by row and data outside the selection is unchanged
Formula bar references/results are consistent with the new positions
After refresh the sorted order remains

tests.title: Sort range by an ISO-format date column ascending and verify dates are compared as dates
checks: Sort by an ISO date column such as 2024-01-15, 2024-01-02, 2023-12-01 yields chronological order, not lexicographic order
Header row remains first and the selected Order is Ascending
After refresh the date-sorted order persists

tests.title: Sort range by a text column with duplicate keys and verify equal keys keep original relative order
checks: Sort by Region text ascending with duplicate Region values; equal sort keys preserve their original relative order
Each record's other columns move together with its row
After refresh the stable sorted order persists

tests.title: Sort range by Sales descending via the Order combo and verify descending order persists
checks: Order combo set to Descending; Sales values are ordered East/1200, North/800, South/700
Header row Region/Sales/Status remains first
After refresh the descending order persists

tests.title: Sort range with Data has header row unchecked so the first row participates and verify persisted
checks: Unchecking Data has header row makes the first row participate in sorting
The original header row is no longer fixed at the top; all selected rows are sorted by the chosen key
After refresh the sorted order including the former header row persists

tests.title: Sort failure displays an error and the grid retains the original order immediately and after refresh
checks: When sorting fails, a visible error is displayed beside the sort dialog/control
The grid continues to show the original row order with no partial sorting
After refresh the original order is still present

tests.title: Create filter and apply value filters on Region and Sales with AND, hiding nonmatching rows only and persisting
checks: Create filter on A1:C6; header buttons named Filter Region, Filter Sales, Filter Status appear
Select Region=East and Sales=1200 in the value-filter dialogs and Apply; only East/1200/Open remains visible
North and South rows are hidden but not deleted or reordered; conditions on the two columns are combined with AND
After refresh the same rows remain visible

tests.title: Apply a Greater than condition on Sales and verify hidden rows are only concealed and persist
checks: Open Filter Sales condition dialog, choose Condition Greater than and Value 700, then Apply
Visible rows are East/1200/Open and North/800/Closed; South/700/Open is hidden
Hidden rows are not deleted or reordered
After refresh the same visible rows remain

tests.title: Export CSV while a filter is active includes hidden rows within the filtered range
checks: With a filter hiding some rows, click Export CSV and start the download
Downloaded UTF-8 CSV contains all source rows including hidden rows in original row and column order
Active worksheet, filter visibility, grid values, and formula bar content are unchanged after export
After refresh the same filter state remains

tests.title: Use value-filter checkboxes generated from distinct source values and Clear selection, then persist visible rows
checks: Value-filter dialog lists checkboxes with accessible names North, East, and South from distinct source values
Clear selection unchecks all checkboxes; selecting East and South and Apply hides only the North row
Hidden rows are neither deleted nor reordered
After refresh the same rows remain visible

tests.title: Clear filter restores all source records in original order and values and persists after refresh
checks: Click Clear filter; rows East/1200/Open, North/800/Closed, South/700/Open become visible in original order with original values
Formula and validation behavior are unchanged
After refresh all rows remain visible

tests.title: Set dropdown validation on A1:A2 with trimmed allowed values and reject an invalid grid entry preserving the original value
checks: Data validation dialog opens with Rule type Dropdown and Allowed values 'East, North, South'; Save closes the dialog
Constrained cells expose buttons named Open dropdown for A1 and Open dropdown for A2; options use ARIA option role and accessible names East, North, South
Entering West in A1 is rejected with 'Please select one of the following values: East, North, South' and A1 retains its original value
Rule remains active after refresh

tests.title: Set inclusive numeric validation 0 to 100 and reject an out-of-range number with the exact message
checks: Data validation dialog with Rule type Number range, Minimum 0, Maximum 100; Save applies the inclusive rule
Entering 150 through grid or formula bar is rejected with 'Please enter a number between 0 and 100' and the original value remains
Valid value 50 is accepted
Rule and values persist after refresh

tests.title: Reject 101 in B3 under a persisted multi-cell 0-to-100 validation rule with 'Please enter a number from 0 to 100'
checks: A multi-cell 0-to-100 numeric rule is already persisted on the target range including B3
Entering 101 in B3 is rejected and the exact message 'Please enter a number from 0 to 100' is displayed
B3 retains its original value and no other cell changes
After refresh the rule and original values persist

tests.title: Reject bulk paste or range move when any target cell violates validation and leave all targets original
checks: Pasting a rectangular block containing at least one invalid value into a validated range rejects the entire paste with the appropriate validation message
All target cells retain their original values; no partial update occurs
Cut/range-move into an invalid target is likewise rejected and both source and target remain unchanged
Error is shown beside the named control and the state persists after refresh

tests.title: Reopen an existing validation rule prefilled and delete the rule without changing existing cell values
checks: Reopening Data validation for the rule shows the saved Rule type and parameters prefilled and a Delete rule button
Clicking Delete rule closes the dialog and removes the dropdown/constraint
Existing cell values remain unchanged
After refresh the rule is still removed

tests.title: Modify an existing validation rule's parameters or range and verify it is effective immediately and persists
checks: Reopen the existing rule; change the rule type, parameters, or target range and click Save
The dialog closes and the new rule is enforced immediately on the modified range
Existing cell values remain unchanged
After refresh the modified rule remains active

tests.title: Create pivot table in new Pivot1 with Rows=Region and Values=Sales (SUM) and verify layout, grand total, and persistence
checks: Create pivot table dialog shows 'Source range: A1:C6' and New worksheet is selected; Create creates worksheet Pivot1
Pivot table editor has Rows=Region, Values=Sales, Summarize by=SUM; Apply succeeds
Pivot1 A1 displays Region and B1 displays 'SUM of Sales'; row groups are East, North, South in first-appearance order
Final row is Grand Total with 2700
After refresh/reopen Pivot1, field layout, and results remain; source worksheet A1:C6 is unchanged

tests.title: Create pivot with optional column field and verify column-field order, grand total column, and grand total row
checks: Create pivot with Rows=Region, Columns=Status, Values=Sales, Summarize by=SUM
Column-field values are arranged from B1 onward in first-appearance order: Open, Closed, then Grand Total
A1 displays Region; row values East, North, South in first-appearance order with Grand Total as the final row
Grand Total column contains East=1200, North=800, South=700, total=2700; Open total=1900 and Closed total=800
Layout and results persist after refresh

tests.title: Use COUNT summarization and verify it counts non-empty records and displays 0 for empty row/column combinations
checks: Set Summarize by=COUNT with Rows=Region, Columns=Status, Values=Sales
East/Open=1, North/Closed=1, South/Open=1, and East/Closed displays 0
Grand total row counts all qualifying records; COUNT does not fail because of empty combinations
Pivot results and layout persist after refresh

tests.title: Use AVERAGE summarization and verify computed averages and grand total preserve source order
checks: Set Summarize by=AVERAGE with Rows=Region and Values=Sales
B1 displays 'AVERAGE of Sales'; East=1200, North=800, South=700
Grand Total averages all qualifying source records and equals 900
After refresh the AVERAGE results persist

tests.title: Refresh pivot table after source value edits recomputes from current source data and preserves source worksheet
checks: Edit a source Sales value, for example East from 1200 to 1500
Click Refresh pivot table; the SUM of Sales becomes 3000 and the old summary is completely replaced
Source worksheet remains unchanged except for the intended edit
After refresh the new pivot result persists

tests.title: Refresh pivot table after row or column structure changes uses the adjusted source range
checks: Insert or delete rows/columns within the pivot source range and click Refresh pivot table
The old summary is completely replaced by a summary computed from the current adjusted source range
New/deleted records and moved source columns are reflected in the refreshed pivot
After refresh the recomputed pivot result persists; source worksheet keeps the changed structure

tests.title: Refresh after a selected source header is deleted displays an error, preserves last successful result, and does not modify source worksheet
checks: Delete a column whose header is selected as a pivot field, then click Refresh pivot table
The error 'Pivot field is no longer available. Select a new field.' is displayed
The last successful pivot result is preserved
The source worksheet contents and structure are not modified by the refresh

tests.title: Invalid source range or field selection on refresh displays a visible error and preserves both worksheets
checks: Use an invalid source range or a field that is not available in the current source range and click Apply/Refresh
A visible error is displayed and the last successful pivot result remains
Neither the pivot-result worksheet nor the source worksheet is modified
After refresh the preserved state remains

tests.title: Apply SUM or AVERAGE to a value field with no parseable numbers and verify 'Value field requires numeric values' preserves old result
checks: Set Rows/Columns to valid fields and Values to a text-only field such as Status with SUM or AVERAGE
The error 'Value field requires numeric values' is displayed
The old pivot result is preserved and the source worksheet is not modified
No partial pivot summary is created
